text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has won the<n>showdown against
her sister at the<n>Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Narita Brian comes over to<n>congratulate her,
Biwa Hayahide has<n>one question.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Am I a big sister you can be proud of<n>now?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's response? "I've<n>always been proud
of you." Today,<n>our winning equation has finally
given<n>Biwa Hayahide the victory she's<n>dreamed of
for so long.
